player_prompt.intro:
Takkarii e Frozen Lake!

A yaaɓɓii 'P' e gridu.
Alaa gridu:
  ' ' = Janngirde mawɗo (ndi yimɓe)
  'H' = Holle (kaɗii ɗum)
  'G' = Ɓangal (kaɗii ɗum wini!)
  'P' = Gonɗal aɓɓiiɓe

Yimɓe e golle: up, down, left, right (walla w, a, s, d)
Wali yimɓe ngam: [up], [down], [left], [right] walla [w], [a], [s], [d]

Hollude: Wali e ɓangal e ɗungu (top-left) e ɓangal (bottom-right) ɗon haani holle!

invalid_move.unknown_action: Unknown action '{action}'. Use up, down, left, right, or w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: You tried to move {action} but hit a wall!

outcome.fell_in_hole: A yani nder luule! Fijirde timmi. A yottini {pct}% laawol yaaki dabare man.
outcome.turn_limit: On yotti keerol man! Fijirde timmi. A hebbi {pct}% nder jaahangal yaaki galle maagal.
